contentPattern: 1 row, 2 cells: [statement paragraph or h2; paragraph with the CTA link, e.g. bold 'Download Copay Savings Card' -> https://accessactivation.apollocare.com/lupin/agravicti/download_pdf, rendered as a black pill with an arrow] | [picture: savings card image]. Full-bleed green band, text left and image right at 900px and up. The CTA opens the hidden same-page section with id 'copay-terms' (Section Metadata Id: copay-terms, Style: modal) in a native dialog with a close button; a CTA whose href is a same-page hash to another 'modal' section opens that one; if the section is missing the CTA is a normal link. Sections carry Tab and Id (card, card-1).
